_note: The on-request 0-100 component score, exactly as SKILL.md 'Scoring — on request only' specifies it. The SKILL owns this model; the dashboard applies it and must not hold its own. Weights anchor to FigmaLint's measured category weights with two deviations argued in Grounding: descriptions 3->10, accessibility split out at 10.
_penalties: Fraction of the dimension's own weight lost per verified finding in it, floored at zero.
_gate: A publication-blocking defect caps the component at 25/100 whatever the other dimensions earn: an unused property means consumers never receive the component at all, and averaging that against good token coverage reports a healthy number for something that does not exist downstream.
_unscanned: A dimension no implemented check feeds is EXCLUDED and reweighted pro-rata, never scored 100 — 'unscanned is not 100', the silence rule applied to arithmetic. The score is then marked partial and the exclusion named. Which dimensions those are is not listed here: it is derived from checks.json, so porting a check closes the gap in one place.
partialNote: no automated check feeds this dimension yet
_catalogue: `catalogue` names this dimension's entry in checks.json. It is how 'is any check running for this dimension?' is answered from data rather than from a list someone remembers to update.
